title: Design: Turning Internal Work Orders off hides the hint lines
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin (a user with every setting, See Financial Data included).
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide at 100% zoom.
  • Have Internal Work Orders turned on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Start on Settings > Work Orders.
  • Open the attached picture iwo-flow0-19-12-settings-turned-off.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Switch off the Internal Work Orders toggle.
  2. Click Save Settings.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The toggle shows off and no window opens.
  • The two hint lines disappear; the toggle name stays "Internal Work Orders" with the same description.

Step 2:

  • The page saves and still shows the toggle off, named "Internal Work Orders".

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11758 (Story 1, Turn on Internal Work Orders, flag internal customers, manage categories)

  • S1-R10: “Turning the toggle off hides the hint lines and the customer badges and leaves the flags on the customers.”
  • S1-R2: “Switching it off opens nothing.”
